description: I am a primary school student who likes coding, reading and drawing.
summary: A playable, interactive 3D browser game titled Loony Outpost, inspired by the NASA Space Apps Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge. It allows the player to make critical decisions and see how their choice affects their entire game. It is important as it teaches kids about making critical decisions but doesn't bore them too much.
details: It allows you to move around a lunar outpost to solve problems there. It teaches kids on critical decision making but still has some games so they will not lose interest in the game. I used AI to make the project. My game is creative as it uses cute characters and mini games to interest kids.
